usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/gpt-image-1.5/edit with JSON body {prompt, images:[imageUrl,...]} (optional: size, quality, background, output_format, output_compression, moderation, input_fidelity). Returns {success, jobId, status:"pending", type}. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with SIWX auth (same wallet that paid) until status=complete; image at body.result.imageUrl.

inputExample.prompt: add a red circle in the center

usage.outputShape: POST returns body.jobId + body.status="pending" + body.type="gpt-image-1.5-edit" (image NOT in POST response). Poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId}: body.status (pending|loading|complete), body.progress (0-100), final edited image at body.result.imageUrl.
quirks: This is the EDIT endpoint (not generate): body requires both prompt AND images (array of >=1 image URLs to edit). Without images it 400s.

Image URLs are validated pre-payment: must return HTTP 200 with an image content-type and NO redirect. Wikipedia upload URLs (UA-gated -> 400) and picsum.photos (302 redirect) were rejected with 'Invalid image URL(s)' (no charge). A direct PNG like https://placehold.co/512x512.png works.
Registry surface price is $0.0090; actual x402 charge was $0.01 USDC on Base for a low-quality 1024x1024 edit (quality/size affect cost).
Async two-step: POST returns {success, jobId, status:'pending'} and does NOT contain the image.
Poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} (NOT /api/generate/.../status) with SIWX wallet auth (free, no payment).
The poll/job endpoint is identity-gated to the wallet that PAID the POST: polling with a different SIWX identity returns 403 Unauthorized. Use the same wallet for POST and poll.
Final edited image at body.result.imageUrl (Vercel blob URL).
usage.guide: Call POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/gpt-image-1.5/edit with JSON {"prompt":"...","images":["<direct image URL>"]} and pay x402 USDC on Base (~$0.01 for low quality). The image URL(s) must resolve to a real image with HTTP 200 and no redirect (placehold.co/512x512.png works; Wikipedia/picsum get rejected pre-payment). You receive {success, jobId, status:"pending"}. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with SIWX auth from the SAME wallet that paid (polling is free) until body.status === "complete", reading body.progress (0-100) along the way. Read the edited image from body.result.imageUrl.
